title: A Inheritance for the Confession
author: Edmund Eastwick
blurb: Xanthe Villalobos, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
